temporal_state_chain.observed: Gary has been working excessively long hours at the hospital, often skipping meals and sacrificing sleep. When Ethan invites him to a weekend retreat, Gary appreciates the concern but says he cannot go because there is too much to do at the hospital.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Gary is overworking himself at the hospital and endangering his health; a relaxing weekend retreat may help him recover and gain perspective.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Gary's refusal shows that his work obligations are overwhelming and that he may not accept help easily.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary remains severely overcommitted and resistant to stepping away, so his health is still at risk.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Find another way to persuade or support Gary in taking a break and addressing his health.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During the retreat, Gary is restless and avoids discussions about work. When Ethan confronts him, Gary says the situation is complicated and that he did not want to burden Ethan with his problems.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary's overwork is primarily tied to professional obligations, though he is concerned about Gary's reluctance and overall health.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Gary's avoidance and admission indicate that the overworking is not only about hospital duties and that deeper personal or complicated issues are involved.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is struggling with more than professional workload and may be carrying burdens alone to avoid burdening others; he needs emotional support.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Encourage Gary to open up and assure him that he can share his problems without judgment.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Gary opens up about the pressures of managing a new department and the personal challenges he is facing. Gary agrees that he could use help organizing his schedule to make time for himself.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan suspects Gary's overwork is tied to deeper personal and professional pressures, but he does not yet know the specifics.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Gary's disclosure confirms and clarifies the deeper causes, and Gary appears receptive to help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary's overwork is driven by identifiable professional and personal pressures; with support, task prioritization, and delegation, he can find a better balance.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Help Gary prioritize tasks, delegate responsibilities, and organize his schedule to improve his work-life balance.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over the following months, Ethan checks in regularly. Gary reports progress and remaining challenges, says he is less overwhelmed, and mentions he had time for a movie last weekend. Ethan sees Gary making efforts to change.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary's situation is understood and that Gary can improve with support, prioritization, and delegation, though change may take time.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Gary's reported progress confirms that the support and changes are working and that Gary is actively improving.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is making meaningful progress toward a healthier work-life balance, though he still faces challenges and benefits from encouragement.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue checking in with Gary, encouraging him, and offering support whenever needed.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After a year, Gary has successfully adjusted to a healthier work-life balance and feels more in control. Gary thanks Ethan for his support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary has been improving and is on track toward better balance, but may still need occasional support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Gary's success shows he can manage independently and no longer needs active intervention.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary has achieved a healthy work-life balance and is capable of managing on his own; Ethan can step back while remaining available.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Step back from active involvement but remain available if Gary ever needs support.
